items.claim: Microsoft reports positive quarterly revenue and GAAP operating income.
items.limitations: Not AI-only profit, cash flow or return on newly invested capital.

items.claim: NVIDIA reports positive quarterly revenue and GAAP operating income.
items.limitations: Supplier earnings do not establish the return earned by compute buyers.

items.source_title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
items.claim: Amazon investment announcement splits an initial amount and a later conditional amount.
items.limitations: Initial and conditional are announcement descriptions, not confirmation of each cash transfer.

items.source_title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
items.claim: OpenAI announces an incremental eight-year AWS purchase expansion, distinct from the investment leg.
items.limitations: Not annual revenue, cash paid, delivered compute or traced use of Amazon investment proceeds.

items.source_title: OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI
items.claim: OpenAI reports a March 31 round close with $122 billion in committed capital and an $852 billion post-money valuation.
items.limitations: Replaces the February headline for this round, not another $122 billion to add; individual cash receipt schedule not verified. Valuation is a financing term, not intrinsic value.

items.source_title: OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI
items.claim: OpenAI describes an approximately $4.7 billion revolving facility as undrawn at the March close.
items.limitations: Zero drawings is specific to the announced closing date, not a claim about current drawings; covenants, security and maturity remain unverified.

items.source_title: NVIDIA partnerships for compute financing platforms
items.claim: NVIDIA and six financial institutions announce memorandums aiming to mobilize more than $500 billion over time; final agreements remain required in that release.
items.limitations: Not a committed fund size, borrower debt balance, deployed capital or final lender terms.

items.claim: A staggered support-tool rollout reports 15% more issues resolved per hour on average in a 5,172-agent study.
items.limitations: Not a universal productivity multiplier or directly observed monetary return; causal interpretation relies on rollout assumptions. Small randomized pilot is distinct from main sample.

items.source_title: Generative AI at Work, version 2 HTML
items.claim: A staggered support-tool rollout reports 15% more issues resolved per hour on average in a 5,172-agent study.
items.limitations: Not a universal productivity multiplier or directly observed monetary return; causal interpretation relies on rollout assumptions. Small randomized pilot is distinct from main sample.

items.source_title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
items.claim: A randomized study of experienced open-source developers using early-2025 tools found 19% longer task completion time with AI access.
items.limitations: Task duration is the denominator; not a 19% economy-wide productivity decline or a current-tool conclusion.

items.source_title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
items.claim: METR's February update says selection and time-measurement problems make its newer speedup estimate unreliable.
items.limitations: Weakens extrapolation from either old or newer raw estimates; not a precise causal replacement estimate.

items.source_title: Measuring the Self-Reported Impact of Early-2026 AI on Technical Worker Productivity
items.claim: A convenience survey of 349 technical workers reports medians of 1.4–2 times perceived work value across three questions.
items.limitations: The range is across question wordings, not a confidence interval; not a randomized output effect, measured cash savings or representative workforce estimate.

items.source_title: IEA Energy and AI: executive summary
items.claim: IEA's April 2025 base case projects about 945 TWh of global data-centre electricity demand in 2030.
items.limitations: Forecast is not observed consumption or energized capacity; no claim this is the newest available forecast.
